findings.title: Billed ICU and room stay duration differs from discharge summary
findings.detail: The hospital bill charges for 3 days of ICU and 1 day of semi-private room, whereas the discharge summary states the patient was shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission (16 Oct 2024) and remained there until discharge on 19 Oct 2024 (1 day ICU and 3 days ward stay).

quotes.quote: Shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission and remained stable in the ward until discharge.

findings.title: Pharmacy bill date precedes discharge prescription
findings.detail: The external pharmacy bill is dated 18 Oct 2024, prior to the date of the discharge prescription on 19 Oct 2024.
